anatomical_limit_frames.note: the ranges are SEATED / normal-ROM ranges; ungated stand/sit motion frames keep the capture, which already leaves them (e.g. anterior pelvic tilt while rising)

chair_complete.rule: ChairCollider (tools/solve_seated_typing_arm_ik.py): margin = signed distance - allowed depth; chair_fabric allows -2.5 cm (seat band), every other part 0

vertical_shift_window_cm.rule: main's propose_vertical_anchor arithmetic per patch on the gated frames: a vertical shift d is allowed when min + d >= band low and median + d <= band high; [lo, hi] empty (lo > hi) means no rigid shift of that set can pass

buttocks.note: median - min > band width: no rigid vertical shift of this patch passes that frame
